title: First Communion Girls 'Gert & Connie', 1930s Snapshot B&W, Center Line MI
description: A 1930s black-and-white outdoor snapshot showing two young girls, named Gert and Connie, dressed in traditional white First Communion gowns and lace veil bonnets. They are positioned in the yard outside a brick house. First Communion represents an important milestone and religious rite of passage in Catholic upbringing.
